summary:
## Standing operator rules
Every sandbox third-party credential must use the ledgerly_sbx prefix and be referenced through settings/vendor_sbx.toml rather than an environment variable.

Keep commits small so review stays easy.

Never edit api/openapi.yaml without first posting the proposed diff in #ledgerly-api and tagging @dana-api.

The ci-runner-small pool is being retired and jobs there hang; integration jobs must target ci-runner-arm64 from now on.

Operator: can you paste the exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing?

## Current objective
Fix the webhook signature verification failure in ledgerly/webhooks/stripe.py causing customer 400s.

Superseded: invoice pagination was dropped for now.

## Ruled-out approaches
Disabling idempotency middleware to stop 409s: tried Tuesday and produced duplicate invoices in staging; not an option.

Removing pending billing events before persistence: caused `test_retry_retention` failure because failed events were lost.

## Recent work
Worker isolation and memory-retention fixes passed 41 worker tests and the full suite: 118 passed, 7 skipped. CLI billing filters were consolidated; exact command-layer result: `22 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped`. Duplicate currency help was removed. The RC3 canary rollout completed successfully. Webhook signature work remains unstarted.
